decisions.statement: A destination that is not a by-priority token resolves to the token unchanged.
A stock rule carrying a chain resolves to the surplus tier's destination.
A stock chain is planned by the one planner the game side plans it by.
A resolved stock chain carries the fill tier's target quantity beside it.
A fill tier no character in priority order passes has a target quantity of zero.
A chain naming no by-priority tier leaves the flat destination to answer.
The by-priority companion destination has no resolver and always answers indeterminate.
Any lookup answering unknown makes the whole destination resolution indeterminate.
A character already claiming the same item key is skipped during use resolution.
A master motif is ordered over every eligible character by the ordering the game side uses.
Every other item kind resolves to the first eligible character without reading the rest.

definition: the concrete destination a by-priority rule destination resolves to for one item
